description: The baseline and cursor for the Pick6 change stream. Developer and Production plans. Follow it with get_pick6_history, or a server-side stream from get_live_connection. Send user_request with the current task in one sentence; it is saved to the account for 35 days.

user_request.description: The current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words. Required on every data call, including follow-ups and pagination. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

name: get_pick6_stream_snapshot
title: Pick6 stream baseline
